title: Contents Packout & Storage Pack-Back Rates and Return Notice Terms
content:
Contents Packout & Storage move-back rates and return terms by tier: the pack-back rate per box, the furniture reset rate per item, the notice required before a scheduled pack-back date, and whether the return waits for a linked rebuild contract.

| Term | On-Site Contents Manipulation | In-Plant Contents Cleaning | Partial Contents Packout | Full Contents Packout | High-Value Contents Packout | Commercial Contents and Records Recovery |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Move back in and unpack per box, USD | 0.00 | 0.00 | 11.85 | 11.85 | 13.20 | 10.90 |
| Move back in, unwrap and set per furniture item, USD | 0.00 | 0.00 | 24.60 | 24.60 | 28.40 | 22.75 |
| Business days (Monday-Friday excluding company holidays) of notice required before a scheduled pack-back date | 2 | 3 | 5 | 5 | 7 | 7 |
| Contents are returned only after a linked rebuild contract at the address reaches substantial completion | no | no | yes | yes | yes | yes |

## Reading the table

- The two tiers without storage carry no pack-back or furniture reset rate (0.00) and do not wait on a rebuild contract.
- Notice is counted in business days, Monday through Friday excluding company holidays: 2 on On-Site Contents Manipulation, 3 on In-Plant Contents Cleaning, 5 on Partial and Full Contents Packout, and 7 on High-Value Contents Packout and Commercial Contents and Records Recovery.

**Hypothetical illustration.** At a per-box rate of 9.00 (not a tier figure), unpacking 40 boxes is 40 times 9.00, or 360.00.
